name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - Fontana CA

fieldNotes.location: 10746 Commerce Way, Fontana CA = the 'Sierra Gateway Center' (addresses 10746-10788 Commerce Way), a ~253,000 SF multi-tenant industrial / distribution building built 1989, ~253 auto parking spaces. GXO Warehouse Company operates here (Buzzfile, Waze). Roster ROOFTOP geocode (54 m) landed correctly on the long N-S building. Located in a dense Inland Empire logistics corridor in Fontana.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck yard / dock apron is on the building's west (rail-adjacent) side. A driveway from the public road at the north connects into the dock apron; chain-link fence runs along the rail corridor but the driveway entrance shows no barrier arm and no guard booth in 2025 Street View. Classified false; flagged uncertain - the driveway is partly tree-screened.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth observed at the yard driveway or building frontage.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors line the building's west face along the rail-side apron; estimated ~38 doors from overhead imagery for a 253,000 SF multi-tenant building - 25-50 band. Flagged uncertain (count from overhead only).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked in the west dock apron - estimated ~24 trailers visible, capacity ~35. No separate dedicated drop lot; trailers occupy the dock apron. 10-25 band.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: The west dock apron provides internal staging room along the rail side before the dock doors.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The west apron runs the full building length and can hold a long truck queue.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs immediately west of the property, but no rail spur enters the building - the apron sits between the building and the rail. Recorded false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Inland Empire industrial fabric in Fontana, surrounded on all sides by warehouses.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated ~16 acres for the Sierra Gateway Center parcel (253k SF building footprint plus dock apron and auto parking).
